description.narrative:
The Project will rehabilitate and improve a 311 kilometer (km) state road from Govindpur to Sahebganj (via Jamtara, Dumka, and Barhet) to a two-lane standard. The improved road will become a backbone of the northeastern part of the state, and connect it to National Highway 2 (NH2), the state's main highway, and to the larger national highway network.
The Project will also enhance the project management skills of the officials of the Road Construction Department (RCD) of the state government of Jharkhand (GOJH) through involvement in activities that are central to project management, such as project design, implementation planning, procurement, land acquisition, resettlement and rehabilitation, environmental management, utility shifting, contract management, and financial management. This will be replicated by RCD for future road improvement projects.

description.narrative: Improved mobility and accessibility in the project area

Travel time on the project roads reduced by 20%-40%, with the overall travel time from Govindpur to Sahebganj reduced from the current 8-10 hours to about 5 hours Progress/Status: Achieved. Travel time on project roads reduced by 44% and travel time reduced to 5 hours 35 minutes from the earlier rate of 10 hours. Data Source: Data collected through the road asset management system to be developed under the institutional strengthening TA Actual value:

Measured traffic growth rates surpass the growth rates used in the economic analysis Progress/Status: Achieved. Average growth rates for car volume are 9.35% against 9% at appraisal; for goods vehicles, 7.5% against 7%; and for bus, 4.83% against 4%. Data Source: Post implementation classified traffic counts (including occupancy and trip purpose) Base year: 2009 Baseline value: N

Vehicle operating costs on the project roads reduced by 12%-30% for two-axle trucks after completion Progress/Status: Exceeded. Vehicle operating costs on the project roads reduced by 32% for trucks. Data Source: Data collected through the road asset management system to be developed under the institutional strengthening TA Base year: 2009 Baseline value: N

Vehicle operating costs on the project roads reduced by 15%-35% for passenger buses after completion Progress/Status: Exceeded. Vehicle operating costs on the project roads reduced by 47% for buses Data Source: Data collected through the road asset management system to be developed under the institutional strengthening TA Base year: 2009 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Systems for improved project management Indicator: Approximately 311 km of state highways rehabilitated or upgraded to two lanes by 2013 Progress/Status: Achieved with delay Upgraded 309.86 km length of state highways by 2017. Data Source: Progress reports of the executing agency ADB review missions Actual value:

Output: Systems for improved project management Indicator: A financial management system, a management information system, and a quality assurance system for improved project management in place Progress/Status: Achieved. At PIC RCD, the financial management system, management information system, and a quality assurance system are in place. Data Source: Project performance monitoring system Project completion report Baseline year: 2009 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2009 Baseline value: N Target year: 2014 Target value: Y
